entity_raw.definition_raw:
You have mastered the powers of another plane.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Planar Infusion, Planar Infusion, character level 13th.

Benefit(s): Choose a plane for which you’ve gained an improved infusion via Improved Planar Infusion. You gain that plane’s greater infusion as well.
